checks.name: migration_readiness_is_executable_and_hash_bound
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import builtins, json, typing
builtins.Path = Path
builtins.Any = typing.Any
package = Path('factoryline/__init__.py')
created = not package.exists()
package.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
package.touch(exist_ok=True)
try:
    from factoryline.migration import assess_migration_readiness, verify_migration_readiness
    categories = ('unit', 'integration', 'e2e', 'lint_type', 'architecture', 'coverage_fuzz', 'environment', 'telemetry_security')
    with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        proof = root / 'proof.json'
        proof.write_text('{"passed":true}', encoding='utf-8')
        manifest = root / 'readiness.json'
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 'factory.migration.readiness-input.v1', 'project': 'smoke', 'checks': [{'id': f'check-{category}', 'category': category, 'command': ['tool', 'verify', category], 'passed': True, 'evidence': [str(proof)], **({'reproducibility_runs': {'passed': 2, 'total': 2}} if category == 'environment' else {})} for category in categories]}), encoding='utf-8')
        receipt = assess_migration_readiness(manifest, root)
        assert receipt['ready'] and receipt['lane_registration_pct'] == 100 and (receipt['executable_proof_pct'] == 100)
        assert verify_migration_readiness(Path(receipt['path']))['ready']
        proof.write_text('{"passed":false}', encoding='utf-8')
        assert not verify_migration_readiness(Path(receipt['path']))['valid']
finally:
    package.unlink(missing_ok=True) if created else None

checks.name: repository_context_is_git_fact_bound
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import builtins, subprocess, typing
builtins.Path = Path
builtins.Any = typing.Any
package = Path('factoryline/__init__.py')
created = not package.exists()
package.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
package.touch(exist_ok=True)
try:
    from factoryline.migration import build_repository_context, verify_repository_context
    with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'init', str(root)], check=True, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'config', 'user.email', 'smoke@example.com'], check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'config', 'user.name', 'Smoke'], check=True)
        (root / 'app.py').write_text('print("ok")\n', encoding='utf-8')
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'add', '.'], check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(root), 'commit', '-m', 'record context'], check=True, capture_output=True)
        receipt = build_repository_context(root)
        assert receipt['tracked_files'] == 1 and receipt['video_overview']['status'] == 'planned'
        assert verify_repository_context(Path(receipt['path']))['valid']
        lore = root / '.factory/context/LORE.md'
        lore.write_text('tampered\n', encoding='utf-8')
        assert not verify_repository_context(Path(receipt['path']))['valid']
finally:
    package.unlink(missing_ok=True) if created else None

checks.name: browser_control_no_finish_is_enforced
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import builtins, typing
builtins.Path = Path
builtins.Any = typing.Any
package = Path('factoryline/__init__.py')
created = not package.exists()
package.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
package.touch(exist_ok=True)
try:
    from factoryline.product_missions import compile_product_prd, plan_value_slices, create_mission
    prd_text = '# Browser proof\n\n## Requirements\n- REQ-DASH: The operator must view the dashboard.\n\n## Acceptance\nScenario: View dashboard\n  Given an operator\n  When the page opens\n  Then the dashboard is visible\n'
    with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        prd = root / 'PRD.md'
        prd.write_text(prd_text, encoding='utf-8')
        graph = compile_product_prd(prd, root)
        slices = plan_value_slices(Path(graph['path']), root)
        mission = create_mission(Path(slices['path']), slices['slices'][0]['id'], root, 'owner')
        browser = next((item for item in mission['completion_contract']['criteria'] if item['verification_kind'] == 'browser_control'))
        assert browser['evidence_contract']['max_clicks'] == 3
        assert 'BROWSER_CONTROL_CRITERION_BOUND' in mission['markers']
finally:
    package.unlink(missing_ok=True) if created else None
